Government of Bangladesh: The Ministry of Finance and the Internal Resources Division represent the executive branch of the government responsible for issuing regulatory notifications related to customs and value added tax.
Ministry of Finance: The Ministry of Finance is the parent ministry responsible for the administration of the Internal Resources Division and the publication of this notification.
Internal Resources Division: The Internal Resources Division acts as the issuing authority for this statutory regulatory order regarding customs and value added tax matters.
Customs: The division manages policy and regulatory functions related to customs operations and duties.
Value Added Tax: The division manages policy and regulatory functions related to value added tax compliance and administration.

Customs Act 2023: This act serves as the primary legal authority enabling the government to issue statutory regulatory orders for customs matters under section 25(1).
Value Added Tax and Supplementary Duty A: This act provides the enabling authority under section 126(1) for the issuance of this regulatory order concerning customs and supplemental tax exemptions.
Pharmaceutical Raw Materials: Goods listed in the specified tables are granted customs duty and supplementary duty exemptions when imported for manufacturing purposes. This concession is strictly limited to government-approved pharmaceutical manufacturers and subject to quantity and value constraints set by the Directorate General of Drug Administration.
TABLE-1: This table lists specific goods for which the applicable customs duty is restricted to five percent, with any excess duty and all supplementary duties being exempted.
TABLE-2: This table identifies specific goods for which the applicable customs duty is capped at ten percent, providing an exemption for any duty amount exceeding this threshold plus all supplementary duties.
